summary: The agent read and rewrote the requirements document for phase P1, updating it with your answers on storage, single-user access, untick behaviour, edit and delete split, done-task display, and task text limits, and listing the out-of-scope items. Both tool calls succeeded, so there are no failures to chase. Before approving, decide two open questions the agent raised: whether whitespace-only task text should be rejected as empty, and what order open and done tasks should appear in (oldest first, newest first, or other).
